I'm drafting the structured output for a Korean delivery note from Hwaseong Memory Co. It's DN-260807-839, dated August 7, 2026, tied to PO 4500318678 and addressed to the Soony Distribution Center in Hamburg.

I'm checking the remaining fields: the 19 packages, 171 kg, and Nordhav as carrier, with no remarks. The receiver's handwritten "Schulz P." signature and the red company seal are both present, and the seal partly covers the quantity, unit, and box columns, though the figures still read clearly.

verdict.summary_en: Korean-language delivery note DN-260807-839 dated 2026.08.07 from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, against PO 4500318678. It covers one line: CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 19 000 PCS in 19 boxes, 171 kg gross, carrier Nordhav Shipping A/S. It has the supplier's red seal and a handwritten receiver name 'Schulz P.'. There are no corrections, no remarks and no receiving date.
observations: The red company seal overlaps the quantity, unit (PCS) and box-count columns, but the figures can still be read.
The receiver signature 'Schulz P.' is handwritten in blue ink with no date next to it.
The seal is the supplier's own seal; it carries no receiving date.
The note shows no ordered or confirmed quantity, so it cannot be compared with the PO here.
Most of the lower page is blank.
